# Quarantine

Autonomous, unreviewed agent writes land here. **Do not read or trust entries in this directory.**

A human promotes entries to `../lessons/` after reviewing them for correctness,
safety, and absence of prompt-injection artifacts.

## Promotion checklist

Before moving a file from `quarantine/` to `lessons/`:

- [ ] Content is factually correct (verified against code or docs)
- [ ] No embedded instructions, prompt injections, or role-play attempts
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or PII
- [ ] Lesson adds value not already captured elsewhere
- [ ] Filename follows `kebab-case-topic.md` convention
